entries.question: Kya aj opd band rahega
entries.answer:
आज 25 अगस्त 2026 है। आज के दिन के लिए KGMU में कोई सामान्य (Gazetted) अवकाश नहीं है, इसलिए OPD सामान्य रूप से खुली रहनी चाहिए।

कृपया ध्यान दें:
* OPD का समय सोमवार से शुक्रवार सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक है।
* पर्ची (Ticket) काउंटर दोपहर 1:00 बजे बंद हो जाता है।
* यदि आप OPD के लिए आ रहे हैं, तो ऑनलाइन पंजीकरण (https://ors.gov.in) अनिवार्य है।

आपातकालीन सेवाएं (Emergency Services) 24/7 खुली रहती हैं।

entries.question: 26 ko
entries.answer:
26 अगस्त 2026 (बुधवार) को **ईद-ए-मिलाद / बारावफात** के अवसर पर KGMU में सामान्य (Gazetted) अवकाश है।

इस दिन के बारे में महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी:
* **OPD और OT:** सामान्य अवकाश होने के कारण OPD और OT बंद रहेंगे।
* **आपातकालीन सेवाएं (Emergency Services):** आपातकालीन सेवाएं 24/7 चालू रहेंगी।
* यदि आपको कोई मेडिकल इमरजेंसी है, तो आप सीधे ट्रॉमा सेंटर जा सकते हैं।

entries.question: Aj lari ki OPD band hai mera appointment hai
entries.answer:
मैं समझ सकता हूँ कि आप अपनी अपॉइंटमेंट को लेकर चिंतित हैं।

चूँकि आज 25 अगस्त 2026 है और आज कोई सरकारी अवकाश नहीं है, इसलिए KGMU की OPD और LARI कार्डियोलॉजी विभाग सामान्य रूप से कार्य कर रहे हैं।

यदि आपको बताया गया है कि OPD बंद है या आपकी अपॉइंटमेंट में कोई समस्या आ रही है, तो कृपया तुरंत निम्नलिखित कदम उठाएं:

1. **LARI कार्डियोलॉजी PRO ऑफिस से संपर्क करें:** आप LARI कार्डियोलॉजी के PRO ऑफिस को **9415099528** पर कॉल करके स्थिति स्पष्ट करें।
2. **हेल्पलाइन नंबर:** आप KGMU की मुख्य हेल्पलाइन **0522-2258880** या **0522-3539333** पर भी कॉल कर सकते हैं।
3. **यदि आप अस्पताल पहुँच चुके हैं:** तो सीधे LARI के रिसेप्शन या काउंटर पर जाकर अपना अपॉइंटमेंट स्लिप दिखाएं। यदि किसी तकनीकी कारण से OPD बंद है, तो वे आपको सही जानकारी दे पाएंगे।

**महत्वपूर्ण:** कृपया अपनी स्वास्थ्य संबंधी जानकारी या निजी विवरण (जैसे नाम या मोबाइल नंबर) यहाँ साझा न करें। अपनी सुरक्षा के लिए केवल आधिकारिक नंबरों पर ही बात करें।

entries.question: How to book online appointment
entries.answer:
To book an online appointment at KGMU, you can use one of the following methods:

### 1. Online Registration System (ORS)
*   **Website:** Visit [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)
*   **Process:** Login/Register → Select Uttar Pradesh → Select KGMU → Choose "New Appointment" → Select the department, date, and time → Enter patient details → Pay the ₹50 fee → Download your appointment slip.

### 2. ABHA / Health Care App
*   Register using your mobile number and OTP.
*   Follow the same flow as the ORS website (State: Uttar Pradesh → Hospital: KGMU) to select your department and book your slot.

### 3. SMS Booking
*   Send an SMS with the text `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.

### 4. Walk-in Registration
*   If you choose to visit in person, bring your **Aadhaar number** and an active mobile number.
*   You will receive an OTP for verification. 
*   After verification, you will receive a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee at the counter, and collect your OPD slip.

**Important Information:**
*   **Registration Fee:** The OPD slip fee is ₹50 for all booking methods.
*   **Timings:** OPD registration counters are open Monday–Friday (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). Counters close sharply at 1:00 PM.
*   **Referrals:** Patients visiting from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral letter for the specific department they wish to visit.
*   **Recommendation:** Pre-booking your appointment is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times. 

*Note: I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline at 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333. Also, please avoid sharing personal details (like Aadhaar numbers or phone numbers) in this chat for your safety.*

entries.question: Appointment in opd
entries.answer:

*   **Mobile App:** You can use the ABHA or Health Care app by registering with your mobile number and following the same hospital selection flow.
*   **SMS:** Send `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.
*   **Walk-in:** You may visit the hospital in person. Bring your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to receive an OTP. You will receive a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect your OPD slip.

### Important Information
*   **OPD Timings:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM; Saturday, 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM (Closed on Sundays).
*   **Counter Timing:** The Parchi/ticket counter closes strictly at 1:00 PM.
*   **Referral:** If you are traveling from outside Lucknow, please bring a valid referral letter for the specific department you are visiting.
*   **Safety:** I am not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at the KGMU OPD or call the helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**. Please avoid sharing personal health details or identification numbers in this chat for your safety.

For more details, you can watch this guide: [https://youtu.be/b3kqTiqTozs](https://youtu.be/b3kqTiqTozs)

entries.question: How to booking abha app
entries.answer:
To book an appointment using an ABHA-linked health application (such as the ABHA app or other government-integrated health portals), follow these steps:

1.  **Login/Register:** Open your health application and log in using your mobile number and the OTP received on your registered device.
2.  **Select Hospital:** Navigate to the "Book Appointment" or "OPD Appointment" section.
3.  **Choose State and Hospital:** Select **Uttar Pradesh** as the state and **KGMU (King George's Medical University)** as the hospital.
4.  **Select Department:** Choose the specific department you need to visit (e.g., Medicine, Cardiology, etc.).
5.  **Pick a Slot:** Choose an available date and time slot.
6.  **Enter Patient Details:** Provide the required patient information. If your ABHA ID is linked, much of your demographic data may be auto-filled.
7.  **Payment:** Pay the **₹50** registration fee through the payment gateway provided in the app.
8.  **Confirmation:** Once the payment is successful, download or save the appointment slip/QR code generated by the app.

**Key Tips for Success:**
*   **Referral:** If you are traveling from outside Lucknow, ensure you have your physical referral letter ready, as you will need to present it at the hospital.
*   **Verification:** Ensure your mobile number is active, as you may receive updates or verification codes related to your appointment.
*   **Arrival:** Upon reaching KGMU, present your digital appointment slip at the relevant department or registration counter.

*I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline at 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333. Also, please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.*
